title: kbtools.py ranks the wrong entry first for the needs query log and how long landing steps take
goal: kbtools.py NEED puts querylog.py first for query log and backlog.py first for how long landing steps take: a name of several words (querylog) matches the words of a need, and a word in a description that names no need (long in long research) does not outrank a command that answers it
notes: Parked by the review of SP-x6eqtsid (reviewer, 2026-10-24; S3). kbtools.words() splits a name only at _, so the name querylog never matches the words query and log (kbmon.py first, querylog.py second for query log); how long landing steps take puts the kb-lookup agent first because Long it-ops-kb research matches long, backlog.py second. Five of thirteen needs the reviewer tried were right first; the kb coverage need left kb_audit out of the first four. The S1 bug BG-nrq2gqcb changes the same matching: take this one after it.
